title: The Apology That Asked Too Much
title_ja: 謝罪が求めすぎたもの
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空例。実在の人物・調査結果・実証的な心理効果を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Maya had promised to help her friend Daniel prepare a presentation, but she forgot about their meeting and spent the afternoon on another activity.
sentences.ja: マヤは友人ダニエルの発表準備を手伝うと約束していたが会合を忘れ、午後を別の活動に費やした。

sentences.en: When she eventually checked her messages, she discovered that Daniel had waited for almost an hour before deciding to complete the task alone.
sentences.ja: ようやくメッセージを見ると、ダニエルが一人で作業を終えると決めるまでほぼ一時間待ったことを知った。

sentences.en: Maya immediately sent a long apology explaining how busy she had been and asking whether he was still angry with her.
sentences.ja: マヤは忙しかった事情を説明しまだ怒っているか尋ねる長い謝罪をすぐ送った。

sentences.en: When Daniel did not respond immediately, she sent several more messages requesting reassurance that their friendship had not been damaged.
sentences.ja: ダニエルがすぐ返事をしなかったので友情が傷ついていないと安心させてほしいというメッセージを何通も送った。

sentences.en: Daniel was disappointed about the missed meeting, but he was also uncomfortable with the pressure to respond to every apology before he had finished preparing for the presentation.
sentences.ja: ダニエルは会合がなくなり落胆したが、発表準備が終わる前に全謝罪に返答する圧力にも抵抗を感じた。

sentences.en: He explained later that he did not want Maya to feel permanently guilty, although he needed some time to deal with the consequences of her mistake.
sentences.ja: マヤにずっと罪悪感を持たせたいわけでないが誤りの影響に対処する時間が必要だったと後で説明した。

sentences.en: Maya realized that her repeated requests for forgiveness had unintentionally created an additional responsibility for the person she had inconvenienced.
sentences.ja: 繰り返し許しを求めることが迷惑をかけた相手に意図せず追加責任を作ったと気づいた。

sentences.en: Her attempts to relieve her own discomfort had partly distracted her from considering what Daniel actually needed.
sentences.ja: 自身の不快感を軽減しようとする試みがダニエルの本当の必要を考えることから一部注意をそらしていた。

sentences.en: The friends discussed the difference between explaining a mistake and offering an excuse that removes responsibility for it.
sentences.ja: 二人は誤りを説明することと責任を取り除く言い訳をすることの違いを議論した。

sentences.en: Maya acknowledged that the missed appointment had caused inconvenience regardless of the reasons why she had forgotten it.
sentences.ja: 忘れた理由に関係なく約束を逃したことが不便を生んだと認めた。

sentences.en: She offered to review the slides after the presentation and to take responsibility for a different part of their next shared project.
sentences.ja: 発表後スライドを確認し次の共同活動で別の部分の責任を担うことを申し出た。

sentences.en: Daniel accepted the offer while explaining that he would prefer to discuss the incident after his immediate obligations were completed.
sentences.ja: 当面の義務が終わった後で出来事を議論したいと説明し申し出を受けた。

sentences.en: Their conversation did not require either friend to pretend that the incident had never occurred.
sentences.ja: 会話は出来事がなかったふりをどちらにも要求しなかった。

sentences.en: Nor did it establish that a particular form of apology would be suitable for every disagreement between friends.
sentences.ja: また特定謝罪形式が友人間の全対立に適切だと確定しなかった。

sentences.en: Instead, they developed a better understanding of the difference between expressing regret and demanding a particular emotional response from another person.
sentences.ja: 代わりに後悔を表すことと他者に特定感情反応を求めることの違いをより理解した。

sentences.en: Maya learned to make a specific effort to repair a mistake without assuming that the other person must immediately restore her confidence.
sentences.ja: 相手がすぐ自信を回復させるべきと思わず誤りを修復する具体的努力を学んだ。

sentences.en: An apology can communicate recognition of harm, but it cannot determine how quickly another person should recover from an unpleasant experience.
sentences.ja: 謝罪は害の認識を伝え得るが他者が不快な経験からどれほど速く回復すべきか決められない。

sentences.en: The willingness to accept responsibility may be demonstrated through actions as well as words.
sentences.ja: 責任を受け入れる意欲は言葉だけでなく行動でも示せる。

sentences.en: Respecting the needs of another person sometimes means allowing them to decide when they are ready to continue a conversation.
sentences.ja: 他者の必要を尊重することは会話を再開する準備ができる時期を本人が決められるようにすることもある。

sentences.en: For Maya, learning to apologize involved learning when to stop asking for an immediate answer.
sentences.ja: マヤにとって謝罪を学ぶことには即答を求めるのをいつやめるか学ぶことも含まれた。

questions.prompt: Why did Daniel complete the task alone?
options: He had refused all help in advance.
He had already finished before the meeting.

questions.prompt: What did Maya seek in her later messages?
questions.explanation_ja: 友情について安心したい。

questions.prompt: Why did the apologies create pressure?
options: He did not receive any messages.
Maya had asked him to change schools.
Daniel was expected to respond while dealing with the original problem.
questions.explanation_ja: 元の問題に対応中に返事を求められた。

questions.prompt: What did Maya realize about her requests?
options: They created additional responsibility for Daniel.

questions.prompt: What concrete offer did Maya make?
options: Review the slides and take responsibility for a future task.

questions.prompt: Why distinguish an explanation from an excuse?
options: Understanding a cause does not necessarily remove responsibility.

questions.prompt: What did the friends not establish?
options: A universal apology method for every disagreement.
The need for a concrete repair effort.
questions.explanation_ja: 普遍的謝罪法ではない。

questions.prompt: What did Maya learn about repairing mistakes?
options: Wait for Daniel to do all the work.
Demand that he forget the event.
questions.explanation_ja: 行動と即時の安心を分ける。

options: A long apology always repairs a friendship.
A responsible apology respects the other person's needs rather than demanding emotional reassurance.

grammar.explanation_ja: 過去完了は忘れる前の約束。

paraphrases.source: Maya had promised to help her friend Daniel prepare a presentation, but she forgot about their meeting and spent the afternoon on another activity.
paraphrases.rewrite: Maya had agreed to help before forgetting their meeting.

paraphrases.source: He explained later that he did not want Maya to feel permanently guilty, although he needed some time to deal with the consequences of her mistake.
paraphrases.rewrite: Daniel did not want lasting guilt, but he needed time to handle the problem.

paraphrases.source: Maya acknowledged that the missed appointment had caused inconvenience regardless of the reasons why she had forgotten it.
paraphrases.rewrite: The appointment caused trouble no matter why Maya forgot it.

paraphrases.source: Nor did it establish that a particular form of apology would be suitable for every disagreement between friends.
paraphrases.rewrite: The conversation also failed to establish a universally suitable apology.
